intent: Despite its header comment describing it as an end-to-end plugin test, this file calls the same MySQLUtils:: free functions as MySQLUtilsTest.cpp, with fewer cases and no plugin dispatch exercised.

objects.name: MySQLTest
objects.role: tpunit fixture with 6 tests, each a thinner rerun of cases already covered in MySQLUtilsTest

misfits.why: its docstring claims to test "the actual plugin behavior end-to-end" as distinct from MySQLUtilsTest.cpp's "utility functions," but every test calls the exact same MySQLUtils:: functions MySQLUtilsTest.cpp already covers; no plugin command handling, socket protocol, or dispatch is exercised, so the claimed integration-test distinction does not hold and this reads as duplicated coverage
misfits.suggested_home: merge into test/tests/MySQLUtilsTest.cpp, or replace with a real plugin-level integration test if one is wanted

name_fit.note: name implies plugin-level coverage the content doesn't deliver

location_fit.note: right directory, but redundant with a sibling file

naming_quality.note: fine in isolation; the MySQLTest vs MySQLUtilsTest distinction is not honored by content
